summary: Source-free #604 finite necessary-carrier analysis. Inspected dossiers for the reused no-contingent-ground, actual-reflexivity and union-WF premises and the new finite-population/local-acyclicity premises. On the necessary subtype (not all beings), finite nonempty population entails a source OR a nonempty Relation.TransGen loop. Assume neither: Mathlib Finite.wellFounded_of_trans_of_irrefl on TransGen yields well-foundedness, and induction constructs a source, contradiction. Rejected the exclusive-fork interpretation: an explicit Fin 3 interpretation has independent source 0 and 1↔2 cycle. Reused unchanged #518 rotating and varying structures and their proved facts: rotating is locally acyclic on the necessary restriction, lacks a source and has a union loop; varying has a source, no loop and a novel possible-world edge. Thus neither union cycles nor variable edges alone imply absence of a source. A source yields the same actual necessary underived individual under actual reflexivity and no-contingent-ground; the source supplies the population witness, and finite population/edge invariance are not required for this bridge. Local acyclicity excludes every loop whose edges are all witnessed in one world, by mapping the whole TransGen path into the local restricted relation. No attribution, root claim, necessity of union acyclicity, uniqueness, global explanation or closure is asserted. The source bridge is recorded as a universal conditional, not a new unproved root-route premise. Root frontier --routes and --reaching-root output are byte-identical before/after.
